name: Mincho Editorial
tagline: Vertical Mincho type cut on the beat between washi cream, vermilion and sumi black.
description: Japanese editorial style for product films, chapters and process reels. Big vertical Mincho words fill in from outline, chapter cards slam in vermilion, a mono script types on, a waveform pulses on the beat, beat squares count up and a red hanko seal stamps the ending. Every cut lands on a 124 BPM beat.
transitions: hard colour-block cut on the beat (cream → vermilion → cream → black → vermilion → cream)
textAnimations: outline word fills top-to-bottom with clip-path inset
mono script types on with a stepped width reveal
hanko seal stamps from scale 2.2 / -18° and shakes
waveform bars spike on each beat, beat squares fill one by one

rhythm.notes: Cut on beats of 60/124 s. Intro 5 beats, chapter card 1 beat, content scenes 2–3 beats, ending ~2.5 beats.

guide:
- Three colours only: washi #efece6, sumi #141414, vermilion #c8102e (white type on red). Grey mono for English glosses.
- Set Japanese headlines vertically (writing-mode: vertical-rl) in Shippori Mincho B1 800; one word or phrase per scene.
- Pick a BPM, define B = 60 / BPM, and place every cut and hit on multiples of B.
- Chapter cards (其ノ壱, 其ノ弐 …) are one beat long on vermilion.
- Pair each Japanese line with a small English mono gloss so it reads globally; keep copy real and short.
- Finish with a hanko seal (完 or the brand initial) stamping in with power4.in and a tiny shake.
